audit.notes: The new chapter blocks comprehensively cover all scientific content present in the old draft. Specifically: Block 1 covers the physics of linear algebra and energy efficiency; Block 2 covers architectural implementations (MZI, MRR, free-space) and photonic crystals; Block 3 covers inverse design methodologies including topology optimization, level-set methods, and adjoint solvers; Block 4 covers AI-driven design acceleration including generative AI, neural operators, and physics-aware surrogates; Block 5 covers the nonlinearity bottleneck; Block 6 covers precision constraints (quantization, thermal drift, FPVs); Block 7 covers environmental/thermal stability (resonator sensitivity, thermal crosstalk); and Block 8 covers application boundaries, heuristic optimization preferences, and specific benchmark results (MNIST/MedNIST). No scientifically useful mechanisms, comparisons, boundary conditions, or quantified results from the old draft are missing.
